Carousel Vouchers

Gift the perfect present of an award-winning feast.

Give the Gift of Singapore's Award-Winning Halal Buffet

Looking for the perfect dining gift in Singapore?

Carousel Buffet Vouchers are a thoughtful way to celebrate birthdays, anniversaries, corporate milestones, festive occasions, or simply show appreciation to family, friends, clients and colleagues.

Located at Royal Plaza on Scotts in the heart of Orchard Road, Carousel is one of Singapore's most recognised halal-certified buffet restaurants, renowned for its fresh seafood, international cuisine, live cooking stations and extensive dessert selection.

Whether you're gifting a buffet dining experience or a flexible value voucher, Carousel vouchers make every occasion more memorable.

Available Voucher Types

Dining Vouchers

Treat someone to a complete buffet experience at Carousel. Dining vouchers are available for Lunch, High Tea and Dinner, and are issued for a specific meal period and day category (weekday or weekend/public holiday).

Value Vouchers

Prefer flexibility? Value vouchers are available in denominations of $25, $50 and $100, and can be used towards buffet dining and hotel room reservations at Royal Plaza on Scotts.

How to Order

Vouchers can be ordered online and collected in person from Carousel's reception counter. Please allow a minimum of three working days for your order to be prepared. For bulk purchases of 20 vouchers or more, please contact us at [email protected].

Order Now
Terms & Conditions
  • Vouchers are valid for 12 months from the date of issue
  • Vouchers cannot be exchanged for cash
  • Cannot be used in conjunction with other promotions, discounts or offers
  • Not valid on public holidays or their eves
  • All prices are subject to 10% service charge and prevailing government taxes
  • Dining vouchers are valid only for the meal period and day category stated on the voucher
  • Dining vouchers cannot be used for Gourmet Carousel food delivery orders
  • Value vouchers may be used for hotel room reservations, subject to prevailing terms and conditions
  • Redemption is subject to availability
  • Only original physical vouchers will be accepted upon arrival
  • Advance order of three working days is required

Frequently Asked Questions

All food prepared and served in Royal Plaza on Scotts and Carousel is certified Halal by Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura (MUIS). The Halal certifications apply to all open kitchen food stations in Carousel and all kitchens of the hotel. These also include the food served in the hotel’s room service and banquet functions.

The certifications are under the “Eating Establishment Scheme (Food Station)”, with strict control measures in place, operators are allowed to serve alcoholic beverages.
